summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Caledonia Mining Corp Plc to report the utilization of its block admission under an At-the-Market (ATM) sales agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald Co. The filing covers the period from December 16, 2025 to June 12, 2026, indicating that no securities were issued or allotted under the scheme during that period, leaving 4,000,000 depositary interests available. No material special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is merely a regulatory update regarding an existing equity distribution facility with no transactional terms disclosed.
